ten_epoch_balanced_supercycle.purpose: equalize short versus long spare-replacement distance exposure across the four logical channels

metrics: short-distance versus long-distance replacement opportunities per channel
homogeneous_loss_invariance_test: under identical iid active/spare loss probabilities at all slots, rotating the spare cannot change per-epoch loss probabilities; only burden distribution changes
claim_rule: rotation is promoted only as exact exposure equalization; reliability benefit under site heterogeneity remains CANDIDATE until a site-dependent channel is supplied
